newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Investors in Brazil Cerj auction announced.
newsitem.headline: Investors in Brazil Cerj auction announced.

text.p: The Rio de Janeiro stock exchange clearing house has published the names of the companies that have pre-qualified to participate in the privatization auction of state power firm Companhia de Electricidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Cerj).
Cerj, which supplies 25 percent of Rio de Janeiro state's electricity and serves around 1.2 million customers, is being auctioned on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange on November 20.
The state is selling its 78 percent stake in Cerj.

Brazilian investors who have pre-qualified are: ABS-Empreendimentos Imobiliarios, Participacoes e Servicos, Bozano, Simonsen Leasing S/A Arrendamento Mercantil, Camargo Correa, Andrea Gutierrez, Distrilight, Escelsa, Fundacao de Assistencia e Previdencia Social do BNDES, Fundacao Sistel de Seguridade Social, Guaraniana, Insituto Aerus de Seguridade Social, Iven, Light, Luz de Rio , Montagens e Projetos Especiais, Consorcio Parcerj, Planalto, Uniao de Comercio e Participacoes, Votorantim Energia, ABF-Participacoes and Lamp Post Participacoes.
